name: matanho-nexus
description: Matanho Nexus - institutional investment platform (portals + shared API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,investor,onboarding,company,custodian -c gray,blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:investor" "npm run dev:onboarding" "npm run dev:company" "npm run dev:custodian"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @matanho/api && npm run build -w @matanho/admin-web && npm run build -w @matanho/investor-web && npm run build -w @matanho/onboarding-web && npm run build -w @matanho/company-web && npm run build -w @matanho/custodian-web
scripts.start:portals: concurrently -k -n admin,investor,onboarding,company,custodian "npm run start -w @matanho/admin-web" "npm run start -w @matanho/investor-web" "npm run start -w @matanho/onboarding-web" "npm run start -w @matanho/company-web" "npm run start -w @matanho/custodian-web"
scripts.verify: npm run db:validate -w @matanho/api && npm run db:generate -w @matanho/api && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:portals && npm run test:offline && bash tools/uat/check-sh.sh
